meta.title: 咔咔 Kaka
meta.description: Kaka, a crab companion for DeepSeek Harness: her own agent preset that never loads workspace AGENTS.md, shared long-term memory and a user portrait across sessions, a daily diary, memory tidying when the night is quiet, a pen that draws SVG (auto-rasterized to 2x PNG and shown inline), crab sounds only (clack, double clack, shell knock, bubble, sand scuttle, chirp — no TTS at all), a pet on the right of the composer that changes mood and holds a pen while drawing, and a 5-second life thread (schedule, alarms, random rambles). kaka_memory / kaka_diary / kaka_journal / kaka_beep / kaka_mood / kaka_remind / kaka_draw exist only in sessions using the Kaka preset. Data lives in $DSH_HOME/kaka/ and survives uninstall; every sound is synthesized locally in the browser and costs nothing.
